key.description: Key is the public Pusher application key.

url.description:
URL is the WebSocket base URL. Omitted: derived from the daemon's
control-plane URL (http→ws, https→wss, same host and path), where the
dashboard proxies /app/* to Reverb.

NudgeConfig.description: NudgeConfig tells the daemon where to receive nudges.

oneOf.description: Nudge is omitted when realtime nudges are off (the daemon only polls).

title: DaemonConfig: signed response to GET /daemon/v1/config
description: DaemonConfig is the signed response to GET /daemon/v1/config: settings the dashboard may change after enrollment.
